title: peer_fetch.rs: SSRF guard skips DNS name resolution check
description: is_valid_fetch_host applies IP-range restrictions only when the host string parses as an IpAddr. Bare hostnames (e.g. evil.attacker.com) pass unconditionally. A malicious peer can store a mailbox_host that resolves to 192.168.x.x or 10.x.x.x at fetch time, reaching internal services. Tailscale MagicDNS names are the intended use case, but there is no enforcement that a stored mailbox_host is actually a MagicDNS name. Mitigation: validate that stored mailbox_host values end with a known tailnet domain suffix, or perform a pre-resolve check before fetch.
